data.title: 2 % of your tax will help us a great deal
data.excerpt: This year again the Hradiská civic association is applying for 2 % of your income tax. In 2025 it produced information panels at the Slavic barrow cemetery of Veľké Hoste and helped on archaeological excavations in Slovakia, and in 2026 it is starting work on the third volume of its hillfort proceedings.
data.metaTitle: 2 % of your tax will help us a great deal

children.text: This year again our civic association Hradiská is applying for 2 % of your tax. In 2025, among other activities, we produced information panels at the 5th Slavic barrow cemetery, Veľké Hoste. We also devoted a considerable part of our activities to helping with archaeological excavations in Slovakia, where we succeeded in rescuing a large number of archaeological finds, some of which literally rewrite the history of the region. Some of them cannot be published yet, but you will be among the first to see them. In 2026 we are also starting work on Zborník o hradiskách 3 (Hillfort Proceedings 3).
So if anyone would be willing to donate 2 % of their income tax to us, the form can be downloaded here.

This year again we are applying for your 2 %, so if you have not yet made up your mind, we will be very grateful for your help.
